categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h, carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label, and modifies HTTP server connection timeout logic.
categories.rationale: Prevents slowloris-style resource exhaustion in the internal HTTP server by imposing an overall request completion deadline. Currently, '-rpcservertimeout' resets on every read, allowing slow unauthenticated clients to trickle bytes and occupy all connection slots indefinitely ('Once those slots are taken, the server stops accepting new connections'). While RPC binds to localhost by default, mitigating HTTP connection exhaustion addresses an explicit security focus area for the RPC interface.
